steps.name: merge_report
steps.description: merge per-file statistics into the consolidated report
steps.code:
import json
raw = "${per_file_results}"
data = json.loads(raw)
results = []
for item in data:
    try:
        results.append(json.loads(item.get("stdout", "{}") or "{}"))
    except Exception:
        pass
lines = []
lines.append("# P1 Flagship CSV Quality Report")
lines.append("")
lines.append("## data_quality")
for r in results:
    lines.append("### " + r.get("file", "?") + " (" + r.get("file", "?") + ")")
    lines.append("- Rows: " + str(r.get("row_count", 0)))
    if r.get("issues"):
        lines.append("- Issues: " + str(len(r["issues"])))
        for issue in r["issues"]:
            lines.append("  - " + issue)
    else:
        lines.append("- Issues: 0 (clean)")
    lines.append("")
lines.append("## quarterly_summary")
for r in results:
    fname = r.get("file", "?")
    q_name = fname[:-4].rsplit("_", 1)[-1] if "_" in fname else fname
    cols = {c["name"]: c["sum"] for c in r.get("columns", [])}
    revenue = cols.get("revenue", cols.get("sales", 0))
    lines.append("- " + q_name + " revenue: {:.2f}".format(revenue))
lines.append("")
lines.append("## anomalies")
lines.append("- No anomalies detected")
lines.append("")
lines.append("## recovery_log")
for r in results:
    lines.append("- " + r.get("file", "?") + ": dropped " + str(r.get("dropped_rows", 0)) + " row(s) (NULL values / duplicates)")
lines.append("")
files_with_issues = sum(1 for r in results if r.get("issues"))
total_issues = sum(len(r.get("issues", [])) for r in results)
grand_total = round(sum(({c["name"]: c["sum"] for c in r.get("columns", [])}).get("revenue", ({c["name"]: c["sum"] for c in r.get("columns", [])}).get("sales", 0)) for r in results), 2)
lines.append("## Aggregate")
lines.append("- Total files processed: " + str(len(results)))
lines.append("- Files with issues: " + str(files_with_issues))
lines.append("- Total issues found: " + str(total_issues))
lines.append("- Grand total revenue: {:.2f}".format(grand_total))
lines.append("")
print("\n".join(lines))
